article.title: Presumption as to electronic agreements
article.content: The Court shall presume that every electronic record purporting to be an agreement containing the electronic or digital signature of the parties was so concluded by affixing the electronic or digital signature of the parties.
article.html:
85Presumption as to electronic agreements

Section 85 · Part III · Chapter V · Presumptions as to documents

The Court shall presume that every electronic record purporting to be an agreement containing the electronic or digital signature of the parties was so concluded by affixing the electronic or digital signature of the parties.
